$comment: Performance budgets for Nova Office hot paths. Numbers are wall-clock milliseconds on CI-class hardware with ~2x headroom over observed local runs, so a failure means a real regression, not noise. Tighten as the real app surfaces land (Phase 13).

fuzzy.rank.500-commands.description: Rank a 500-command set against a typical 4-char query — one keystroke's work in the command palette.

fuzzy.rank.cold-first-keystroke.description: First keystroke against 500 commands (single char, widest result set).

motion.spring.10k-samples.description: 10,000 closed-form spring evaluations — a frame's worth of many concurrent animations.

tokens.build.description: Full design-token build (JSON -> CSS + SCSS + TS + JSON). Runs in CI before install, so it must stay fast.
